works.author: Nixtio
works.comment: 洗衣服务网站与移动 App 同屏亮相，平板上配送追踪与订单状态一目了然，浅色界面配绿色点缀干净清爽；本地生活服务用“一块平板 + 一条配送进度”把下单到送达的全流程一次讲清。
works.comment_en: A laundry service site and app appear side by side, with delivery tracking and order status clear on a tablet in a clean light interface touched with green; one tablet and one delivery timeline tell the whole order-to-doorstep story.
works.title: Laundry Service Website & Mobile App Design

works.author: Ronas IT | UI/UX Team
works.comment: 儿童学习 App：明亮配色里课程、任务与奖励徽章排得满满当当，大圆角卡片与卡通插画透着童趣；儿童产品用“高饱和配色 + 奖励徽章”把学习做成一场收集游戏。
works.comment_en: A kids' learning app packs lessons, tasks and reward badges into bright colors, with big rounded cards and playful illustrations; high-saturation color plus reward badges turn studying into a collection game.
works.title: Elementary School - Kids Learning App

works.author: Samuel Oktavianus
works.comment: 生物科技实验室自动化网站首屏：机器人手臂与检测流程大图镇场，深色科技感配蓝色光效，标题文案直指自动化；硬核 B2B 官网用“一幅实验场景大图 + 一句自动化承诺”把实验室效率讲得像科幻片。
works.comment_en: A biotech lab-automation website hero: a robotic arm and testing workflow fill a large image in dark tones lit with blue, headlined by an automation promise; one lab scene and one promise make lab efficiency read like science fiction.
works.title: ordivalabs: Biotech Laboratory Automation Website - Hero UI

works.author: RonDesignLab
works.comment: 血糖追踪戒指 Aera：深色健康 App 里血糖曲线起伏分明，戒指渲染图与睡眠、活动指标并排；可穿戴配套 App 用“一条曲线 + 一枚戒指”把全天候健康监测收在一屏。
works.comment_en: Aera, a glucose-tracking ring companion: a dark health app shows the glucose curve front and center beside a ring render and sleep and activity metrics; one curve and one ring fit round-the-clock monitoring on a single screen.
works.title: Aera — Glucose Tracking Ring Companion

works.author: Moonsight® Agency
works.comment: 企业财务工作台 Eva：AI 驱动的银行、薪资与审批界面收在一部手机里，深色卡片配绿色数字冷静专业；金融工具用“一部手机 + 三块业务”把银行、发薪、审批三件事并成一条工作流。
works.comment_en: Eva, an AI-driven finance workbench: banking, payroll and approvals fit on one phone, with dark cards and green figures keeping it calm and professional; one phone and three business areas fold banking, payroll and approvals into a single workflow.
works.title: Eva — App Design & UX/UI. Banking, Payroll & Approvals

works.author: Imran Hossen
works.comment: AI 电商销售助手 Arbling：SaaS 仪表盘里 AI 引流、收入机会与客户旅程数据层层展开，紫色点缀提亮深色界面；AI 电商工具用“一块仪表盘 + 一条客户旅程”把“AI 帮你卖货”讲得有凭有据。
works.comment_en: Arbling, an AI sales agent for e-commerce: a SaaS dashboard layers AI-driven traffic, revenue opportunities and customer-journey data, with violet accents brightening the dark interface; one dashboard and one customer journey make "AI sells for you" concrete and credible.
works.title: AI Sales Agent | AI Commerce SaaS Dashboard

works.author: Naimur Rahman
works.comment: 事件状态页编辑器：故障处理步骤、更新编辑器与各组件可用性时间线排在一屏，绿色“运行正常”与黄色“处理中”一眼可辨；SaaS 运维工具用“一份步骤清单 + 一条时间线”把故障沟通做得透明又体面。
works.comment_en: A status-page incident editor: incident steps, an update editor and per-component uptime timelines share one screen, with green "operational" and amber "investigating" readable at a glance; one checklist and one timeline make outage communication transparent and dignified.
works.title: Status Page Incident Update UI – Customer Communication & Uptime

works.author: Orizon
works.comment: 餐厅收入仪表盘：浅色与深色双模式并排，收入汇总、利润目标与热销菜品三块数据一屏到位；餐饮 SaaS 用“双模式切换 + 三块核心数据”把一家店的生意讲得明明白白。
works.comment_en: A restaurant revenue dashboard in light and dark modes side by side, with revenue summary, profit goals and best-selling dishes all on one screen; dual themes and three core metrics lay out a restaurant's business at a glance.
works.title: Restaurant Revenue Dashboard

works.author: QClay
works.comment: AI 助手 Perq：邮件分类、日程安排与文档整理建议收在一个轻盈的聊天界面里，卡片式建议点一下就能执行；个人 AI 助手用“一段对话 + 几张可执行卡片”把杂事处理变得像聊天一样轻松。
works.comment_en: Perq, an AI assistant: email triage, scheduling and document-organizing suggestions live in a light chat interface, where card-style suggestions are one tap from done; one conversation and a few actionable cards make busywork feel like chatting.
works.title: Perq- AI Assistant
